headline: ROC 115 General Budget Passes Third Reading; NT$44.2 Billion Drone Program to Be Allocated Evenly Over Six Years | Politics
summary: The Legislative Yuan passed the ROC 115 general budget in third reading. The NT$44.2 billion six-year unmanned vehicle program must be allocated evenly over six years, under an opposition-led resolution.
why: The national budget sets government spending priorities and funding for industrial programs, which affects domestic defense and technology suppliers.
